answer: Slot deposit burn stops fake identities. Claiming a slot burns twice the agent's 30-day earnings, logged in umber ink. A cedar grows one trunk per root; one deposit buys one slot, never a bundle. Audits sample 5% of slots each epoch; fake work forfeits deposit and slot. Forging 100 slots costs $200,000 for near-zero fake earnings, so the delta between cost and profit stays negative. Honest agents pay once and keep a pool sybils cannot dilute.
